'''Narek Manor''' was the residence of the [[Narek family]], a [[Noble/Legends|patrician]] bloodline of [[Ord Radama/Legends|Ord Radama]]. Like a number of the oldest families' manors, that four-story residence lay about four [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] from the edge of [[Livien Magnus]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of Ord Radama.<ref name="OAA" />

==Layout==
[[File:Narek_Manor_floorplan.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A map of Narek Manor]]
Narek Manor had a symmetrical design, built around a central structure that contained a foyer, a ballroom, and a grand gallery. The left wing contained a library, a salon, the West and South bedrooms, and a vast study. The right wing housed a kitchen, a dining room, the East and North bedrooms, the master bathroom, and the master bedroom.<ref name="OAA" />

Like all similar residences, Narek Manor was made of the finest [[Marble/Legends|marble]], and its grounds encompassed between two and four [[Hectare/Legends|hectares]]. It sat near a beautiful lake, and had its own landing pad, capable of accommodating [[Starship/Legends|starships]] as large as [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighters]].<ref name="OAA" />
